## Diversity-cost check

Per the Transcendence Principle, every governance mechanism should be
evaluated against its diversity cost. How does this proposal affect
agent / module / approach diversity?

- [ ] No diversity impact (purely defensive)
- [ ] Light coordination (System 2 damping) — preserves diversity
- [ ] Heavy control (System 3 mandate) — justify diversity cost
